title: Memorable Vacation in Thailand with FREE Tickets to Phuket Big Buddha
highlights: Have a memorable vacation in Thailand as you make a visit to its iconic attractions and have experiences from its stunning cities like Phuket and Krabi.
Marvel at the breathtaking limestone cliffs of Maya Bay, the iconic paradise featured in the 2000 movie "The Beach," starring Leonardo DiCaprio.
Spend some time in peace at the famous Big Buddha of Phuket, one of the city's most cultural and religious symbols and admire its beauty as you visit it.
Explore the beautiful Phra Nang Beach, famous for its dramatic limestone cliffs and secret caves, offering a unique spot for relaxing in nature.
Visit the famous Viking Cave, renowned for its admirable ancient wall paintings and the harvesting of bird nests used in traditional dishes.
overview:
About the tour:
From the crystal clear water, scenic beaches to enthralling adventures and more, Phuket is drawing people to its shores for decades. Often referred to as the Pearl of the Andaman, it is the largest island in Thailand and arguably the most famous one as well. With an exceptional coastline featuring long stretches of white sandy beaches fringed with casuarinas and palms, Phuket is undoubtedly a must-visit destination to have a fun-filled vacation.
On the other hand, lies the stunning town of Krabi along the coast of Southern Thailand. A place boasts of emerald blue waters, gleaming white sands, limestone cliffs and dense green wildlife sanctuaries. It is a cherry on top for adventure junkies for Krabi offers some thrilling adventure sports like wakeboarding, windsurfing, kitesurfing and much more.

know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: Welcome to Thailand, the "Land of Smiles"! Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, you'll be transferred to Krabi, a charming town nestled along southern Thailand's coast. Upon your arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. You can spend the rest of the day exploring the city at your own pace. Visit the beautiful Emerald Pool and see Ao Luk Mangroves or relax at Klong Thom Hot Springs. Later, return back to the hotel at your convenience.

days.title: Krabi 4 Island Tour
days.desc: Get transferred from the hotel to Klong Jilad Pier. From there, take the speedboat ride to Railay Beach. Upon arrival, explore Phranang Cave. Next, marvel at the chicken-shaped rock formation at Chicken Island before indulging in a mouth-watering lunch. Continue your journey to Tup Island, known for its pristine white sand beach and limestone formations, and Poda Island, where you can swim, sunbathe, or enjoy snorkeling. Afterward, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Phuket
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and prepare yourself for a scenic journey to Phuket. En route, admire the stunning views of Southern Thailand's coastline with its towering limestone cliffs, lush greenery, and pristine beaches. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, you can explore the city on your own and see places like Freedom Beach, Raya Islands, and Wat Srisoonthorn, among others. Afterward, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Phuket Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: From your hotel, board the pre-booked transfer for the Phuket sightseeing tour. During this day trip, you will explore various attractions of the city, starting from Karon Viewpoint, which offers views of famous beaches in Phuket. Next, see the iconic Big Buddha, a tall statue overlooking the island. Continue the journey to Wat Chalong Temple, followed by a visit to the Old Town. Later, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
days.desc:
Get transferred from the hotel to the Royal Phuket Marina and board your speedboat to Phi Phi Island. Upon reaching there, spend your time exploring the beautiful Maya Bay, known for its stunning sunset. Next, explore Loh Samah Bay for 
amazing views of limestone cliffs and crystal-clear waters. As the tour continues, you will see the famous Viking Cave, followed by a visit to the beautiful Monkey Beach. Later, board your pre-booked transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day at Leisure in Phuket
days.desc: Take this day at your leisure by relaxing at the hotel or exploring the charming town of Phuket at your own pace. You can enjoy the vibrant nightlife by strolling along Bangla Road (Soi Bangla), where you can find international-standard nightclubs, street performances, live music, and more. Alternatively, you can unwind at beautiful beaches in the city like Kata Beach, Tri Trang Beach, and Banana Beach. Afterward, return to the hotel at your convenience for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: As your unforgettable time in Thailand comes to an end, it's time to pack your bags and check-out from the hotel. You'll be transferred to the airport for your flight back home. This is where your trip ends. Have a safe journey!
